title: Arabic Calque Dictionary Schema v1.2.0
description: Schema for arabic-corpus-toolkit calque-dictionary.json. Compatible with humanizer v2.3.0+ (base schema), v2.6.0+ (triage additions), and v2.6.3+ (topic-guard additions). See references/03-api-design.md for design rationale.

$schema_version.description: Asset-level SemVer. v1.0.0=base; v1.1.0 adds v2.6.0 triage fields; v1.2.0 adds v2.6.3 topic-guard fields. Use exact-match for breaking changes.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata: source, version, mining provenance

en.description: The English source term. May include parenthetical disambiguation, e.g., 'view (database)' to distinguish from a UI sense.

ai_default_calque.description: The Arabic calque that AI translators typically produce. This is what the humanizer detects in input and replaces.

natural_arabic.description: The natural-Arabic replacement. Corpus-attested or institutionally-authoritative.

alternatives.description: Other natural-Arabic options. Informational; the lex pass uses natural_arabic.

domain.description: Domain tag (e.g., tech-data, tech-software, business, news-journalism, politics, climate, healthcare, tech-ai-agents, tech-crypto).

confidence.description: Source of confidence. 'high_user_attested' = native-speaker reviewed; 'topic-guarded' = re-added with context_keywords gate after v2.6.0 emergency triage.

corpus_hits.description: Frequency in the AITNews corpus (2.88M tokens).

llm_votes.description: Per-LLM vote in the multi-LLM swarm that produced this entry.

regional_sensitivity.description: v1.1.0 (v2.6.0 of humanizer): regions where this term is sensitive.

political_sensitivity.description: v1.1.0: editorial risk level. 'high' / 'critical' entries should not be silently substituted by automation; flag for review.

disambiguation_pair_id.description: v1.1.0: links entries that must be considered jointly (e.g., refugee + displaced person).

disambiguation_warning.description: v1.1.0: free-text editorial guidance for the LLM cognitive pass.

applies_only_in_domain.description: v1.1.0: hard domain filter — substitution skips if input domain isn't listed.

v2_6_triage_note.description: v1.1.0: provenance note recording why this entry was added/changed in v2.6.x.

context_keywords_arabic.description: v1.2.0 (v2.6.3 topic-guard): positive gate. At least context_keywords_required_count Arabic keywords must appear within ±100 chars of the candidate match.

context_keywords_english.description: v1.2.0: positive gate — English keywords (e.g., 'SQL', 'PostgreSQL') often appear in tech-context Arabic prose.

context_keywords_required_count.description: v1.2.0: how many keywords from the Arabic+English lists must hit to fire the substitution. Default 1.

exclude_if_pattern.description: v1.2.0: regex patterns that block the substitution even when Layer 1 positive gate passes. Critical for 'رؤية\s+\d{4}' (Vision XXXX) class exclusions.
